description: Java Servlet class for deleting an employee record, handling POST requests to delete an employee based on ID and redirecting or forwarding based on success.

classes.name: DeleteEmployee
classes.description: A servlet that handles deletion of employee records, invoked via '/DeleteEmployee' URL pattern.

methods.name: doPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests for deleting an employee, retrieves employee ID, calls database utility method, and redirects or forwards based on the operation result.
